newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Steyr 1996 net profit almost doubles.
newsitem.headline: Steyr 1996 net profit almost doubles.

text.p: Austrian auto maker Steyr-Daimler-Puch AG said on Wednesday group net profit almost doubled in 1996 making it possible for the firm to reinstate a six percent dividend after four years without a payout.
In a statement released ahead of a news conference, Steyr said net profit jumped to 200.4 million schillings from 104.2 million in 1995.
Pre-tax profit increased to 202.6 million schillings from 108.4 million and sales rose to 11.4 billion schillings, up from 10.7 billion.

The firm said the positive trend continued in the first quarter of this year, with sales rising 11 percent to 2.9 billion schillings, and forecast a further rise in full-year earnings. -- Vienna newsroom +43-1 531 12 254
